title: Denmark original control follow-up survey
row_unit: One original source record; original order retained.
transformation: Column projection only, plus source_row; no row filtering, joins, value recoding or imputation.
notes: 993 unique source IP identities have no direct equality overlap with public baseline IPNR. No individual linkage, random-assignment claim, or canonical phase scoring is implied. Original questionnaire responses, municipality/county codes and labels retained; postal code POSTNR omitted. CPR_KMNK is municipality code, not a personal civil-registration number.
